name: Max Weber
role: German sociologist, political economist and publicist (1864-1920)
summary: German liberal-nationalist political economist and sociologist who put the power interests of the nation state above economic class interests and argued for a strong parliament and a directly elected, plebiscitary president as the way to select political leaders against rule by officials. He saw modern life as bureaucratising and disenchanted, held that conflicting ultimate values cannot be settled by science or reason, and doubted that socialism could do more than extend bureaucracy.
